items.title: Police dismantle Kratos phishing platform, arrest developer
items.description: Authorities in Germany and the U.S. dismantled the central infrastructure of Kratos, a phishing-as-a-service (PhaaS) platform with global reach, and its developer was arrested in Indonesia. [...]

items.title: FakeGit campaign uses 7,600 GitHub repos to push SmartLoader malware
items.description: A large-scale operation dubbed 'FakeGit' is pushing SmartLoader and StealC malware through 7,600 malicious GitHub repositories that accumulated more than 14 million downloads. [...]

items.title: Ransomware Is Accelerating, But It's Not Because of AI
items.description: Researchers pointed to fragmentation of the ransomware ecosystem, the emergence of new attackers, and expansion of attacks on less defended organizations.

items.title: Using LLMs to Find and Prioritize Vulnerabilities Is No Easy Task
items.description: The latest large language models have high false-positive rates and fail to take into account the context of scans, leading to more work for AppSec professionals.

items.title: Critical SharePoint RCE flaw exploited to steal machine keys
items.description: Hackers are actively exploiting the critical CVE-2026-50522 vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint to steal machine keys and maintain access even after affected servers are patched. [...]

items.title: Anubis ransomware claims Coca-Cola Fairlife attack, threatens data leak
items.description: The Anubis ransomware gang has claimed responsibility for the cyberattack on Coca-Cola's Fairlife dairy subsidiary, threatening to publish allegedly stolen corporate data unless the company pays a ransom. [...]

items.title: Hacker Turns AI Jailbreaks Into Offensive Attack Platform
items.description: A Russian-speaking actor, "Trim," dismantled publicly available frontier models and integrated them with offensive security tools.

items.title: Trump Orders Defense Contractors to Map Software, Suppliers Across Critical Supply Chains
items.description: New executive order calls for end-to-end visibility into defense supply chains, including software dependencies, foreign ownership and cyber-related supplier risks. The post Trump Orders Defense Contractors to Map Software, Suppliers Across Critical Supply Chains appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Cisco Launches Low-Cost AI Models for Source Code Security
items.description: The open-weight Antares models are designed to pinpoint known vulnerabilities in codebases faster and at a fraction of the cost of larger AI models. The post Cisco Launches Low-Cost AI Models for Source Code Security appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Critical wp2shell WordPress flaws exploited to install webshells
items.description: Hackers are exploiting the "wp2shell" critical vulnerability suite (CVE-2026-63030 and CVE-2026-60137) affecting WordPress Core to deploy persistent webshells and install malicious plugins on affected servers. [...]

items.title: Choose Wisely: AI-Generated Coding Risk Varies, a Lot
items.description: AI-generated code introduces 15 vulnerabilities on average per codebase, but the actual risk depends on framework pairing more than the model used.

items.title: Empirical Security Raises $25 Million in Series A Funding
items.description: The startup will use the investment to accelerate the development of its threat prediction and discovery products. The post Empirical Security Raises $25 Million in Series A Funding appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: SecurityWeek Launches Critical Impact Awards to Recognize Excellence in Industrial Cybersecurity
items.description: Independently judged and sponsor-neutral, the new awards program honors the people, organizations, and technologies delivering proven impact in industrial cybersecurity; winners to be announced live at the 2026 ICS Cybersecurity Conference in Nashville The post SecurityWeek Launches Critical Impact Awards to Recognize Excellence in Industrial Cybersecurity appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: New HollowGraph Malware Abuses Microsoft 365 Calendar for C&C Communication
items.description: Part of a larger toolkit, HollowGraph uses a compromised 365 account’s calendar as a two-way dead-drop. The post New HollowGraph Malware Abuses Microsoft 365 Calendar for C&C Communication appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: 'WP2Shell' Opens Millions of WordPress Sites to Remote Takeover
items.description: Barely three days after disclosure, attackers are widely chaining together CVE-2026-60137 and CVE-2026-63030 to lob exploit attempts against one of the largest attack surfaces on the Internet.

items.title: Student Loan Breach Exposes 2.5M Records
items.description: 2.5 million people were affected, in a breach that could spell more trouble down the line.

items.title: Watering Hole Attacks Push ScanBox Keylogger
items.description: Researchers uncover a watering hole attack likely carried out by APT TA423, which attempts to plant the ScanBox JavaScript-based reconnaissance tool.

items.title: Tentacles of ‘0ktapus’ Threat Group Victimize 130 Firms
items.description: Over 130 companies tangled in sprawling phishing campaign that spoofed a multi-factor authentication system.

items.title: Ransomware Attacks are on the Rise
items.description: Lockbit is by far this summer’s most prolific ransomware group, trailed by two offshoots of the Conti group.

items.title: Cybercriminals Are Selling Access to Chinese Surveillance Cameras
items.description: Tens of thousands of cameras have failed to patch a critical, 11-month-old CVE, leaving thousands of organizations exposed.
